html:
-- Game time anchor. Written by the Ayanad sync bot, do not edit by hand.
-- Use /gametime sync in Discord when the wiki shows the wrong game time.
-- gt = game minutes since 00:00 at the real moment utc (epoch seconds). The game clock runs rate times faster
-- than real time and starts at 12:00 after every server restart.
return {
	utc = 1794814238,
	gt = 1304,
	rate = 6,
	precise = true,
	by = "auto check",
	updated = "2026-11-16 07:30:38 UTC",
}
